Peer Review of Evidence: A Model for Debate

Jane Doe jane@example.com

Abstract. A shared evidence library lets every team check a card's source before the round. We propose a review queue that scores cards by citation quality.

    1. Introduction

Evidence quality varies widely between teams because there is no shared standard for checking a source before it is read in a round, and judges rarely have time to verify a citation themselves.

Hash0 Hash1

    2. Review Queue

Each card enters a queue where two reviewers check the citation independently

and the card is published only when both reviewers agree that the quote matches the source.
